integrity: The claim is proved analytically from the printed stochastic equations. The source's equations (10)-(12), stability conditions (16)-(18), Parameter Set 1, and bibliography were inspected directly. A bundled standard-library checker reproduces the exact boundary exponents and counterexample arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The result gives exact boundary-direction necessary conditions, not a complete nonlinear stability classification.
The explicit sigma=3 counterexample tests the unrestricted theorem statement and is not claimed to be the noise level used in the source's simulations.
Finite-time simulation behavior is not contradicted by failure of mean-square exponential stability.
The separate omission of complement factors in the stochastic replicator equations is outside this finding.
title: Noise-blind moment stability fails in a stochastic agri-food evolutionary game
